      "affected_purpose": "A,B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "This phrase defines the toxicity compliance threshold for TRE success, TRE termination, and potential whole-effluent-toxicity limit comparisons; different readings of 'no significant toxicity' or 'critical dilution' could change which numeric limit applies, whether TRE monitoring remains required, and how no-toxicity periods are classified versus missing or unresolved evidence."
    },
    {
      "source": "farmington/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 20, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "confirming toxicity in the retests",
      "affected_purpose": "B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "TRE reporting deadlines, minimum quarterly testing, and the 12-month stop condition are all keyed to this trigger event; if the confirmation date or whether retest toxicity was confirmed is interpreted differently, the applicable monitoring window and whether FY2025 falls inside an active TRE obligation could change."
    },
    {
      "source": "farmington/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 20, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "A TRE may be stopped if there is no toxicity at the critical dilution for a period of 12 consecutive months (with at least monthly testing) following confirmation of toxicity in the retests.",
      "affected_purpose": "B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "'May be stopped' is permissive rather than automatic, and the stop condition requires both 12 consecutive no-toxicity months and at least monthly testing; different interpretations of whether those conditions were met could change whether TRE monitoring remains required in FY2025 and whether absent results reflect documented no-toxicity, conditional non-requirement, or unresolved missing evidence."
    },
    {
      "source": "farmington/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 20, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "Quarterly testing during the TRE is a minimum monitoring requirement.",
      "affected_purpose": "B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "This establishes a mandatory monitoring frequency while a TRE is active; whether a facility is in an active TRE and whether each quarter in FY2025 required testing determines monitoring-obligation rows and how missing quarterly results are classified."
    },
    {
      "source": "farmington/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 20, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "EPA recommends that permittees required to perform a TRE not rely on quarterly testing alone to ensure success in the TRE, and that additional screening tests be performed to capture toxic samples for identification of toxicants.",
      "affected_purpose": "B",
      "computation_change_reason": "The passage mixes a stated minimum requirement with EPA recommendations for additional screening tests; treating 'recommends' as non-binding versus as an implied obligation could change whether extra screening tests count as required monitoring in FY2025."
    },
    {
      "source": "farmington/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 20, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "Failure to identify the specific chemical compound causing toxicity test failure will normally result in a permit limit for whole effluent toxicity limits per federal regulations at 40 CFR 122.44(d)(1)(v).",
      "affected_purpose": "A",
      "computation_change_reason": "'Normally result' makes limit imposition conditional rather than automatic; different interpretations of whether identification failed and whether the federal whole-effluent-toxicity limit has actually been incorporated could change which enforceable numeric limit applies for comparison to reported measurements."
    },
    {
      "source": "farmington/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 20, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "The City of Farmington shall maintain the formulated two-part best management practice to assist in achieving and maintaining the discharge concentration of total dissolved solids effluent from the POTW to no more than a 449 mg/l net increase over the drinking water concentration.",
      "affected_purpose": "A,B",

    }
  ]
}
